_readme: Measurement input for `npm run rag:quality`. Never read by the server, the indexer or the knowledge endpoint.

Each case names the ONE document that should answer it. Questions are worded so that exactly one allowlisted document can answer them - a question two documents could legitimately answer measures the question set, not the retrieval.
expectedDoc: null marks a negative case. Those must return no match at all; they exist so that lowering the similarity threshold cannot silently buy hit rate with false matches.
Every expectedDoc must be present in config/rag-allowlist.json - the loader enforces this so a stale question set fails loudly instead of looking like a retrieval regression.
